bullets: Developed Go-based microservices for a HubSpot-Intelliflo integration, implementing reliable data synchronization across multiple independently deployable repositories and services.
Designed webhook-driven processing using Google Pub/Sub and Cloud Functions, filtering incoming events and routing each request to the appropriate downstream service for asynchronous processing.
Integrated PostgreSQL with PgBouncer connection pooling to control concurrent database connections and improve application reliability under load.
Implemented GitHub Actions pipelines with path-based change detection, deploying only the affected microservice, Cloud Function, or infrastructure component instead of rebuilding the entire system.
Provisioned and managed cloud resources using Terraform with remote state stored in Amazon S3, enabling reproducible and version-controlled infrastructure deployments.
Dockerized Go services and stored container images in Google Artifact Registry, using Gorilla Mux to implement HTTP APIs and webhook endpoints.

Developed a React-based operational interface for identifying failed data synchronizations and enabling users to retry or resolve failed records, improving system recoverability and operational reliability.
Completed a one-month internship developing full-stack web applications using the MERN stack.
Implemented REST APIs and contributed to the Wallet-Watch project.
Completed a one-month internship focused on MERN stack development.
Collaborated with the development team to build and maintain web application features.
